description: Kenya - Infrastructure assessment for health facilities is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Demographics", published or maintained by World Bank Group. Health facilities in Kenya were acquired from a local consultant through the KEMRI Wellcome Trust Research Programme. These facilities were used to assess hospital preparedness based on available infrastructure data (GSM coverage, electrification, access (drive time)) and demographics (population and vulnerability to CoVID). Additionally summary statistics were generated at the ward level. Coverage: Kenya. It has 4 files in XLS, ZIP. The portal files it under Demographics. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
